verdict.rationale: Decagon documents general 'guardrails' and AOPs that let teams define agent behavior in natural language, which could in principle be used to mark certain topics as human-only, but no evidence describes a specific human-only topic flag, escalation rule, or guarantee that the agent will never act on legal/cancellation/security topics. Missing for 10: explicit human-only topic tagging feature, hard escalation enforcement mechanism, and independent/hands-on confirmation that agents never freelance on flagged topics.
